title: Fix Telegram Stars replay attack: save and check provider_payment_charge_id
description:
## Task: Prevent Stars payment replay attack in aiogram bot

### Context
FishBot — Telegram bot. Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x, SQLAlchemy 2.x async, PostgreSQL.
File: `bot/handlers/payment.py`, `bot/db.py`

### Security Bug (CVSS 5.0)
`provider_payment_charge_id` from Telegram Stars payment is never stored or checked.
An attacker could reuse the same payment notification to get multiple subscriptions.

### Current code (payment.py)
```python
@router.message(F.successful_payment)
async def successful_payment(msg: Message, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
    payload = msg.successful_payment.invoice_payload  # e.g. "stars_pro_30"
    charge_id = msg.successful_payment.provider_payment_charge_id  # NEVER CHECKED

    parts = payload.split("_")
    plan, days = parts[1], int(parts[2])

    user = await get_user(session, msg.from_user.id)
    await activate_subscription(session, user.id, plan, days, tx_id=None)  # tx_id=None!
    await msg.answer("✅ Подписка активирована!")
```

### Payment model (db.py)
```python
class Payment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "payments"
    id = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = mapped_column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id"))
    plan = mapped_column(String(32))
    amount = mapped_column(Integer)
    currency = mapped_column(String(16))
    tx_id = mapped_column(String(256), unique=True, nullable=True, index=True)
    status = mapped_column(String(32), default="pending")
    created_at = mapped_column(DateTime, server_default=func.now())
```

### Fix needed
Pass `charge_id` as `tx_id` to `activate_subscription`. The function already has idempotency:
```python
async def activate_subscription(session, user_id, plan, days, tx_id=None):
    if tx_id:
        existing = await session.execute(select(Payment).where(Payment.tx_id == tx_id))
        if existing.scalar_one_or_none():
            return  # already processed — idempotency guard
    # ... rest of activation
```

### Deliverable
Updated `successful_payment` handler that passes `charge_id` as `tx_id`.
One-line fix with explanation. Valid Python 3.12.
